entries.title: the numbers a competitor published about us were right, and so was the refusal we had shipped over twice
entries.summary: A benchmark run by someone else, against our own tool, named two real defects. TypeScript and TSX never indexed an `abstract class` at all, because the grammar spells it as a node type neither language spec listed, so every abstract class was absent and its methods lost their owner (#698). And `search_symbols` cut its page with a heap keyed on score alone, so an exact-name match could be evicted outright by same-named locals declared inside function bodies -- not ranked lower, absent (#699); all three cut sites read one rule now. Beside them, `/release` step 4 had refused three consecutive releases on the same six benchmark rows and two shipped over it: the per-repo cells in both READMEs are derived from `benchmarks/jcm_reference.json` now, and a ratchet gates the cells a reader actually reads rather than the grand total everyone remembers to update. Also in the block: `get_tectonic_map` partitions by Louvain instead of returning one plate holding most of the repository (#668) and its co-churn signal runs and says when it cannot be trusted (#667), changed paths resolve when the index is rooted below the git top level (#685), a triage result the model cannot produce is escalated instead of retried forever (#670), committing a tree no longer invalidates the full-tier stamp taken on it (#675), the inbound jobs that bill a model have their own switch and it is off, and `import-trace --diagnostics` maps a checker's own output to the symbol it names.

entries.title: the process is code that cannot skip a step, and the field is measured from result files
entries.summary: Three layers ship in this block, every one off by default where it can act: the workflows layer (seven Claude Code commands and the hooks that refuse a commit without the fast tier, a PR without a full-tier run on the tree it describes, and every irreversible verb), the inbound layer (nine headless jobs that draft and never post, the model never holding a token that can write) and the competitive tier (the null alternatives, jCodeMunch and nine competitors over pinned corpora in a sandbox, every recorded number written by a script from a result file). Beside them: the usage-site question reaches the tool that answers it (CF-63), a failed embedding batch names its cause (CF-66), the watcher's startup and its deletion reconciliation (#641, #629, @marcelruhf), a notice for installs on tree-sitter-language-pack 1.x (#608, @kecsap), the CodeQL triage's fixes (#628) and an sdist without `.github/`.

entries.title: A display preference edited the data it was displaying
